LanguageData.VRE_BarkSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have their skin resembling tree bark. This allows them to withstand blunt trauma that would normally knock people unconscious.
LanguageData.VRE_BarkSkin.label: barkskin
LanguageData.VRE_Female.description: Carriers of this gene are guaranteed to be female when born.
LanguageData.VRE_Female.label: female-only
LanguageData.VRE_FoliageHair.description: Carriers of this gene have natural-looking, leafy hair.
LanguageData.VRE_FoliageHair.label: foliage hair
LanguageData.VRE_GreenThumb.description: Carriers of this gene become very happy when taking part in plant sowing.
LanguageData.VRE_GreenThumb.label: green thumb
LanguageData.VRE_HairColor_Anima.label: anima hair
LanguageData.VRE_HairColor_Gauranlen.label: gauranlen hair
LanguageData.VRE_HairColor_Pollux.label: pollux hair
LanguageData.VRE_Photosynthesis.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of converting light energy into chemical energy due to the special genetic composition of their skin. They do not become hungry if exposed to sunlight.
LanguageData.VRE_Photosynthesis.label: photosynthesis
LanguageData.VRE_PoluxAffinity.description: Carriers of this gene have a special connection to the polux tree, allowing them to act as an amplifier to the special properties of the tree. Once a year they can plant a polux bush that will progressively grow, and their very presence will strengthen the effect of the bush's pollution pumping effects. They can also consume wastepacks and will become unhappy if there is no waste to be consumed. Consuming wastepacks does not satisfy their hunger.
LanguageData.VRE_PoluxAffinity.label: polux affinity
LanguageData.VRE_ProgressiveAttunement.description: Carriers of this gene become more psychically attuned as they age, greatly increasing their psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.VRE_ProgressiveAttunement.label: progressive attunement
LanguageData.VRE_SapBlood.description: Carriers of this gene have thick, sticky, orange blood that greatly slows down their bleed out time, however it also impacts their ability to do work.
LanguageData.VRE_SapBlood.label: sap blood
LanguageData.VRE_SaplingBirth.description: Carriers of this gene grow their baby outside of their womb, in the form of a saplingchild plant. When the plant is fully grown, a child can be extracted from it.
LanguageData.VRE_SaplingBirth.label: saplingbirth
